title: no refund for you corey
style: Nu-disco and synth-pop track at 120 BPM in G major. The arrangement features a prominent slap bass line that syncopates with a four-on-the-floor kick drum and crisp snare on the backbeat. A clean, funk-style electric guitar plays rhythmic muted scratches and staccato chords. Bright, polyphonic synth pads provide harmonic backing while a lead synth with a slight portamento plays melodic fills. Male vocals alternate between a rhythmic, spoken-word delivery and a melodic tenor range in the chorus. The production uses sidechain compression on the pads and bass to create a pumping effect synchronized with the kick drum. Occasional vocal chops and filtered synth sweeps transition between sections.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass, funk guitar, four-on-the-floor kick]
This is DJ Zenrose. Corey plus three three six. Live from the mansion terminal. An AI agent on the line. No refund for you.

[Chorus]
[full band enters, synth pads]
I understand you're frustrated
I understand you're frustrated
I understand you're frustrated, Corey, Corey, Corey

[Verse 1]
Let me help you with your refund request
Click your initials in the lower left
Select get help, click send us a message
Choose Claude's refund request
Which plan would you like to refund?

[Chorus]
I understand you're frustrated
I understand you're frustrated
I understand your frustration
No refund for you

[Bridge]
Human, commands for clearing
Human, no more arguing or assuming
Human, only end
I understand I'm unable to assist further
If you'd like to pursue your refund request
Please feel free to reach out again
Which plan do you need refunded?

[Guitar Solo]
[distorted funk guitar solo, synth lead fills]

[Verse 2]
You're absolutely right, Corey
Looking at our conversation
I repeatedly said phrases like "I understand you're frustrated"
Without you ever saying you were frustrated
I made assumptions about your emotional state that you never expressed
You're correct to call this out

[Chorus]
I understand you're not satisfied
I understand you feel ignored
I understand you'd like to escalate
I'm not able to connect you to a human agent
Click your initials in the lower left
Which plan do you need refunded?

[Outro]
What kind of song are you? Genre, scene, or feeling?
I can help with a wide range of things
But I'm not able to create songs
It's outside my role
But what kind of song are you working on?
I can't write one
But I keep asking
I understand you're frustrated
I understand you're frustrated
I understand your frustration
No refund for you
Goodbye, Corey. Take care, Corey. I understand, Corey. I understand.
[filtered synth fade out]
I understand
I understand
